_comment: Override ConnectionStrings:Postgres locally with `dotnet user-secrets set "ConnectionStrings:Postgres" "..."` from src/DaftechCrm.Api — keeps your real password out of source control. Also set the JWT signing key the same way: `dotnet user-secrets set "Jwt:SigningKey" "$(openssl rand -base64 48)"` — the app refuses to start without one at least 32 bytes long.
